name: SB-216641
summary: SB-216641 is a drug which is a selective antagonist for the serotonin receptor 5-HT1B, with around 25x selectivity over the closely related 5-HT1D receptor. It is used in scientific research, and has demonstrated anxiolytic effects in animal studies.

pharmacology.text: SB-216641 is a drug which is a selective antagonist for the serotonin receptor 5-HT1B, with around 25x selectivity over the closely related 5-HT1D receptor.

uses.text: It is used in scientific research, and has demonstrated anxiolytic effects in animal studies.

fact.en: The 5-HT1B and 5-HT1D receptors are so alike that telling them apart in experiments is difficult. SB-216641 was made to prefer 5-HT1B, which made that work possible.
fact.zh: 5-HT1B 和 5-HT1D 受體非常相似，在實驗中很難區分。SB-216641 被設計成偏好 5-HT1B，讓這項研究得以進行。
fact.zhHans: 5-HT1B 和 5-HT1D 受体非常相似，在实验中很难区分。SB-216641 被设计成偏好 5-HT1B，让这项研究得以进行。
